data.title: Bitcoin slides toward $60,000 as ETF outflows and liquidations intensify
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin fell to a four-month low over the weekend, approaching a major liquidation zone near $60,000 as institutional outflows, leveraged selling and expectations of higher U.S. interest rates pressured cryptocurrency markets.
